name: singlet_immune_repertoire_tcr_clonotype_definition
title: TCR clonotype definition and grouping
description: Assigns each cell with paired TCR chains to a clonotype by exact CDR3 identity (default, nucleotide) or by an amino-acid distance threshold, blocking links across donors by default, and records the rule in uns/clone_definition. Use it to define clones before clonal expansion, overlap or specificity analysis. Do not use it for B-cell receptors, where somatic hypermutation needs clonal family inference, and do not compare clone counts across definitions without the recorded rule.

dataset.description: Dataset handle: a .singlet path or URI (local path, s3://, r2://, https://) or a workspace handle.

method.description: identity_nt is the default; hamming, levenshtein and tcrdist are amino-acid distance graphs and need cutoff.

receptor_arms.description: Chains that must match; all combines chain distances by maximum, any by minimum.

dual_ir.description: Chain pairs considered per cell; primary_only uses the most abundant pair by UMI count.

same_v_gene.description: Require identical V genes for linked cells.

same_j_gene.description: Require identical J genes for linked cells.

within_group.description: Columns that must match for two cells to be linked; donor_id blocks cross-donor merging.

cutoff.description: Maximum distance counted as a match; null uses 2 for hamming and levenshtein, 20 for tcrdist; refused for identity methods.

graph.description: Graph partitioning options for distance methods.

partitions.description: Partition of the thresholded graph; connected is the default and does not use seed.

resolution.description: Leiden resolution; ignored unless partitions is leiden.

n_iterations.description: Leiden iterations; ignored unless partitions is leiden.

seed.description: Random seed for Leiden partitions; no effect otherwise.

device.description: Execution device; auto picks CUDA when a device with enough memory is available.

dry_run.description: Return estimated time, memory and device without running.

overwrite.description: Replace existing output members instead of failing.

dataset.description: Handle of the dataset that was (or would be) updated.

status.description: completed: ran inline and wrote members; dry_run: only an estimate was computed; queued: running as a long job (see job_id).

wrote.description: Members written, e.g. obs/clone_id. Empty for dry_run and queued.

summary.description: For completed calls: n_cells, n_assigned, n_clonotypes, n_multichain and rule. Never raw matrices.

provenance_id.description: Id of the provenance record appended to the dataset (null unless completed).

estimate.description: Present for dry_run: seconds, peak_memory_gb, device.
